nodes.label: SpiceSentry project context
nodes.description: Maintained architecture and decisions; update source-backed semantic facts when architecture changes.

nodes.label: Firestore primary ledger
nodes.description: Primary business database: Google Cloud Firestore project kvs-traders, database (default). Purchases and sales are transaction collections; users and config retain identity and settings.

nodes.label: Authenticated Node API
nodes.description: Same-origin Node API accesses Firestore using server-only Firebase Admin credentials.

nodes.label: Signed account sessions
nodes.description: Four-digit PIN authentication produces an eight-hour HttpOnly session cookie. The server rechecks role, active state, and credential version; new/reset PINs use scrypt.

nodes.label: Account and branch isolation
nodes.description: Staff access is restricted to the assigned branch. Each data request carries the current tab expected account ID to reject stale-account tabs.

nodes.label: Per-account durable submission outbox
nodes.description: Complete submitted purchases and sales are synchronously saved to account- and ledger-generation-scoped localStorage before UI acknowledgement.
nodes.rationale: A rejected or unfinished remote write must not erase a newly acknowledged submission on normal same-browser reopening; clearing browser storage still loses unsynced records.

nodes.label: Durable transaction sync stages
nodes.description: Durable stages are primary commit, spreadsheet mirror, and mirror-status confirmation. Failures remain visible and retry on foreground or reconnection.

nodes.label: Atomic idempotent primary commit
nodes.description: The server creates a primary record and Asia/Kolkata daily summary atomically, reusing the original record ID. Lost-response retries must not duplicate a record or increment totals again.

nodes.label: Derived branch/day summaries
nodes.description: Firestore daily_summaries stores derived branch/day totals alongside primary purchases and sales.

nodes.label: Google Sheets reporting mirror
nodes.description: An external Apps Script receives reporting copies. The deployed write handler is absent from the repository; exactly-once delivery depends on that handler deduplicating stable transaction IDs.

nodes.label: Account and generation scoped display caches
nodes.description: Display caches and outbox keys isolate accounts and ledger generations. Inactive enqueue and old-tab pagehide writes cannot repopulate the current generation. Caches are not backups.
nodes.norm_label: account and generation scoped display caches

nodes.label: Kallar retirement
nodes.description: Supported branches after the requested retirement are 20 Acre and Anachal. Kallar is retired; selectors, API validation, seed configuration, voice parsing, and integration catalogues must agree.

nodes.label: Ledger reset lifecycle
nodes.description: Completed user-authorized reset on 21 September 2026: deleted 139 Firestore purchases, 7 sales, 21 daily summaries; cleared 242 spreadsheet purchase rows and 8 sale rows. Both stores verified empty; all five accounts retained. Ledger reopened at12:42:11 UTC. Private backups remain outside the repository.
nodes.rationale: Reset requires a private backup outside the repository, blocked writes during maintenance, and verified empty target collections before writes reopen. Independently retained spreadsheet mirrors must be documented.

nodes.label: Ledger generation and invalidation
nodes.description: Firestore _system/ledger generation is checked inside each business-write transaction. Client caches and pending queues are scoped by account and generation; inactive enqueue and pagehide writes are guarded. The external Apps Script remains a separate direct-writer limitation.

nodes.label: Graph context versus business ledger
nodes.description: Graphify artifacts provide source navigation, not a business database or backup. The local allowlist-based refresh merges checked-in semantic facts without model API calls or live database reads; verify findings against source files.

nodes.label: Node hosting requirement
nodes.description: Development runs the frontend and same-origin API at localhost:5173. Production needs build plus a Node service, HTTPS APP_ORIGIN, private session secret, and server Firebase credentials. A static dist upload cannot provide login.

nodes.label: Historical verification snapshots
nodes.description: The login and storage recovery documents contain historical test, build, lint, and browser results. Present validation must use current command output; local checks or a Git push do not establish public deployment.

nodes.label: Separate optional MCP MongoDB integration
nodes.description: The optional mcp-server uses MongoDB separately from the web application primary Firestore ledger.
